import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react' import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase' import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext' import { Link, useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom' import { User, Mail, Calendar, Trophy, BarChart3, Heart, Building2, DollarSign, FileText, Users, UserPlus, CheckCircle, Plus, Phone, Settings as SettingsIcon, MessageCircle, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react' import VerifiedBadge from '../components/VerifiedBadge' import FollowButton from '../components/follow/FollowButton' import ProfilePicture from '../components/ProfilePicture' export default function Profile() { const { userId } = useParams() const { user, profile: currentUserProfile } = useAuth() const navigate = useNavigate() const [profile,
